facts.fact: WordStream's 2026 all-industry median cost per click on Facebook traffic campaigns is $0.60 (vendor-reported, U.S. campaigns).
facts.quote: WordStream's 2026 Facebook benchmarks are medians by objective: $0.60 CPC on traffic, $1.80 CPC and $27.39 per lead on leads.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2026 all-industry median cost per click on Facebook leads campaigns is $1.80 (U.S. campaigns).
facts.quote: $1.80 CPC and $27.39 per lead on leads.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2026 Facebook traffic-objective sample covers 1,377 U.S. campaigns running from April 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
facts.quote: 1,377 U.S. Facebook campaigns running from April 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2026 Facebook leads-objective sample covers 452 U.S. campaigns in the same April 2025 to June 2026 window.
facts.quote: 452 U.S. Facebook campaigns in the same window.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2026 all-industry median traffic CPC of $0.60 is lower than the prior report's $0.70, which WordStream's table shows as 14.29% lower.
WordStream's 2026 all-industry median click-through rate for Facebook traffic campaigns is 1.93%.
WordStream's 2026 all-industry median conversion rate for Facebook leads campaigns is 8.54%.
In WordStream's 2026 data, the Home and Home Improvement median cost per click on traffic campaigns is $0.63.
facts.quote: On traffic campaigns, Home and Home Improvement is $0.63 per click.

facts.fact: In WordStream's 2026 data, the Home and Home Improvement median cost per lead on leads campaigns is $42.95.
facts.quote: On leads campaigns, that category is $2.18 per click, a 5.32% conversion rate, and $42.95 per lead.

facts.fact: In WordStream's 2026 data, the Dentists and Dental Services median cost per lead is $61.56.
facts.quote: Dentists and Dental Services are $61.56 per lead.

facts.fact: Meta reported Q2 2026 advertising revenue of $59.363 billion, up 27% from a year earlier (total spend, not a per-click price).
facts.quote: $59.363 billion, up 27% from a year earlier

facts.fact: Meta reported that its average price per ad rose 12% year over year in Q2 2026.
facts.quote: Average price per ad:** up 12% year over year.

facts.fact: Meta reported Family daily active people of 3.60 billion on average in June 2026, up 3% (reach, not price).
facts.quote: Family daily active people:** 3.60 billion on average in June 2026, up 3%.

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing ladder puts Facebook, Instagram, and Google Search on at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Facebook, Instagram, and Google Search are on at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states TikTok runs from $91 a day when turned on in Customize and a TikTok account is connected; it is not in the default mix.
facts.quote: TikTok runs from $91 a day when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account

facts.fact: The page cites $1,000 to $1,500 a month as a common planning budget for a first Facebook test, explicitly not a required spend.
facts.quote: $1,000 to $1,500 a month is a common planning budget for a first test. It is not a required spend
